content:
**98 NAR Regional** is a location in the Savage Divide region of Appalachia. The location is situated north of New Appalachian Central Trainyard.

The site of a terrifying railway accident, the 98 New Appalachian Railroad Regional transport collided with a military train carrying weapons and robots, with several derailed Traincars blocking the roadway through the mountains, having collided with east and westbound cars and Buses. The crash site spans a section of the Blue Line railway, and across Highway 63 over to the woodlands to the east. [Pub 1] 

The area consists of two derailed Trains running north to south. A central area is flanked by two rows of derailed Traincars. Bisected by the four-lane Highway 63, rows of derelict cars are lined up on both sides. On the west side of the roadblock, half of a Bus can be found.

A military Traincar on the west side sits atop a rocky outcrop, the car accessible from below. The interior was used as a residence, and contains various loot and a level 2 Safe. Multiple hostile robots are encountered here, including a Sentry Bot. In the overturned red car at the northern end of the wreckage, the quest item RCX01-A39 Duplexer can be found.

- Potential Vault-Tec Bobblehead - Inside an overturned Military Boxcar north of the tracks, accessed via the underside, on a small book cabinet near the bed.
- Potential Magazine - Inside the same Military Boxcar, laying on the patterned couch.
- Potential Mod - Inside an overturned Military Boxcar on the southern end of the tracks.
- RCX01-A39 Duplexer - Quest item, in the overturned red car at the northern end of the wreckage.

98 NAR Regional appears in *Fallout 76*.

All of this is snarled up in a large and slowly rusting maze. Check under one of the balanced carriages for a hidey-hole."*
